thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-09 carries a coherent but negative macro thread: crude pushing toward $100 on a Mideast flare-up, the 30-year mortgage rate at its highest since June 2025, and a note that bond-market selling is already showing up in earnings -- together pointing to inflation/rate pressure. That argues for caution, not for adding to the core sleeve, and it's not a reason to sell a small, long-held diversified ETF position either. The rest of the pack is single-name energy/AI/crypto commentary and routine politician PTR filings. Existing VTI position (~22.6 of ~107.6 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than reacting to macro headline risk, consistent with capital preservation.
